B12.visual_intent: A four-row table on the cream stage, one row ringed as each output is named: ALBEDO, ALPHA, EMISSION and ROUGHNESS with METALLIC (the last two share a row), each with a short plain meaning. The note names the docs page.

B13.visual_intent: A left-to-right flow on the cream stage. A box 'fragment()' emits a small card of five monospace chips (ALBEDO, ALPHA, EMISSION, ROUGHNESS, METALLIC) labelled 'surface'. The card travels into a box 'Godot's lighting'. Two lamp icons drop beams into the same box from above. A single teal pixel (a small outlined square) comes out on the right. All arrows are drawn shapes that point only forward.
B13.motion_claim: A surface card enters Godot's lighting, two lamps feed it from above, and one pixel comes out.

show.event: fragment() box and its surface card
card enters the lighting box; lamps feed it

B13.why: A flow of work with a token moving forward through named stages is what a Manim flow shows best, and the two lamps joining the card are the 'every lamp' of the sentence.

show.event: the left square vanishes from behind

B18.visual_intent: A small decision sketch. At the top a teal square labelled 'looks wrong'. Two branches go down. Left: a lamp icon with a question mark leads to a shaded sphere that turns flat, tagged 'add unshaded'. Right: a flat square seen from behind (empty outline) leads to the same square filled, tagged 'add cull disabled'. A dot travels down each branch in turn; a third tag 'blend add' appears faint at the side with the caption 'more modes in the docs'.
B18.motion_claim: A dot travels down each branch and lights its remedy tag.

show.event: right branch: back side, then cull disabled

B18.why: Two questions with their one-word remedies are a gate with two exits; a travelling dot walks the viewer through both.
